question: The value of ((1-cot θ)/(1-tan θ))²+ 1, if 0° < θ < 90°, is equal to:
solution:
Given:

0° 

Concept used:

cotθ = cosθ/sinθ

tanθ = sinθ/cosθ 

cosec²θ - cot²θ = 1

(A - B)² = (B - A)²

Calculation:

((1-cot θ)/(1-tan θ))² + 1

⇒ ({{1 - {cosθ over sinθ}} over {1 - {sinθ over cosθ}}})² + 1

⇒ ({ {{sinθ - cosθ} over sinθ} over {{cosθ - sinθ} over cosθ}})² + 1

⇒ ({ {{cosθ - sinθ} over sinθ} over {{cosθ - sinθ} over cosθ}})² + 1

⇒ ({cosθ over sinθ})² + 1

⇒ cot²θ + 1 = cosec²θ

**∴ The value of ((1-cot θ)/(1-tan θ))²+ 1 is cosec2θ.**
